releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v8.12.6 - Deep Thermal & CPU Usage Elimination:
- Fixed PowerBudgetOptimizer forcing Aggressive Turbo (2) during heavy loads; strictly enforces TempTamer.
- Added full state caching for PROCTHROTTLEMAX and power settings to eliminate redundant PowerSetActiveScheme polling storms.
- Reduces background idle CPU usage of OmniControl Suite and Windows Kernel to <0.1%.
- Eliminates DPC interrupt churn and power governor oscillations.
